name: Yanagi Ryouta
source:
The popular teacher in charge of civics, with a refreshing outward appearance. He teaches about ethics and modern society but he doesn't believe that they have any value whatsoever, so he finds it funny that he's teaching those subjects. Having a violent temperament in contrast with his appearance, it seems these destructive impulses have led him to furiously damage property behind the scenes. When his hair is brushed back, he changes so much that he looks like another person. It seems that he and Tojo are childhood friends.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/08/bad-medicine-infectious-teachers/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
